name: ZeroB AS1 - Water Softener-1000LPH
summary: The primary function of the ZeroB AutoSoft 1 is to condition the incoming hard water to a softer form, which improves the experience of bathing, washing, and laundering and eliminates the scum formation and scaling effects of hard water on appliances and bathroom accessories.
intro: The ZeroB AS1 conditions incoming hard water into a softer form at flow rates of 1000 LPH, improving the experience of bathing, washing and laundering while eliminating scum formation and scaling effects of hard water on appliances and bathroom accessories.
features: Fully automatic programmable process valve with zero manual intervention
Softens water and prevents scale, scum and corrosion damage to bathroom fittings and appliances
Reduces detergent and soap consumption while protecting fabric colour and texture
Increases the lifespan of washing machines, water heaters and other appliances
Uses ZeroB's proprietary Purple Resin Media (RESIN Technology)
